assumptions.funding: short receives +rate, weighted by P_t/P_entry (fraction of entry notional)
assumptions.exit: Donchian-10 close > prior 10-bar high, max 60 bars, or delisting settlement (last traded price)
assumptions.dataSource: Binance spot/USDT-M perp klines & fundingRate; Gate.io CEL spot; OI history unavailable (Binance openInterestHist only ~30 days)

scanSummary.note: Binance USDT-M perps (TRADING+SETTLING listed in exchangeInfo), daily, 2023-01-01..2026-10-04; episode = close <=20% of max close within prior 30 bars, peak bar quote vol>=5M USDT; d20 = close < prior-20-bar low; P&L: short next open, exit close>10-bar high or 60 bars, cost 0.3%/side, funding excluded
